wasteTypeLabel: Idle Fabric, Synapse and Data Explorer compute
name: adx-telemetry
costSource: estimated (2 x Standard_E8ads_v5 VM plus engine markup list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: Data Explorer cluster (2 x Standard_E8ads_v5) ingested 5,000 MB but answered 0 queries in 30 days: data goes in and nobody reads it
suggestedAction: Stop the cluster (data is kept and it can be started again), or confirm with the resource group owner that nothing reads it and delete it.
referenceCommandNotExecuted: az kusto cluster stop --name adx-telemetry --resource-group rg-telemetry

name: fw-dev-dnat
idleSource: DataProcessed and rule hit metrics, 30 days
costSource: estimated (Standard deployment list price, eastus; capacity units and data processed extra, Retail Prices API)
reason: 0 application or network rule hits and 300.0 MiB processed in 30 days (Standard), but the deployment fee bills every hour. Some traffic still flows (DNAT rules have no hit metric), so check what routes through it first
suggestedAction: Check route tables (forced tunneling, hub routing) and any planned spokes that send traffic through it. If it is not needed, delete it, or deallocate it to keep its configuration without the hourly fee (Azure PowerShell: $fw.Deallocate(); Set-AzFirewall $fw).

wasteTypeLabel: Idle NAT, VPN and ExpressRoute gateways and circuits
name: nat-dev-unused
costSource: estimated (NAT gateway list price, Retail Prices API)
reason: NAT gateway is attached to no subnet; its public IPs keep billing too
suggestedAction: Delete it, or attach it to the subnets that need outbound access. Release its public IPs if they aren't needed.

name: cosmos-dev-idle
costSource: estimated (600 RU/s fewer x 2 region(s), manual throughput list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: 1,000 RU/s provisioned across 1 database/container scope(s), and no request units were consumed in 30 days. With autoscale, lower the autoscale maximum instead
suggestedAction: Lower the provisioned throughput (or the autoscale maximum) to about 400 RU/s in total, then watch for throttled (429) requests. If traffic stays this low, serverless may cost less still.
referenceCommandNotExecuted: az cosmosdb sql database throughput update -a cosmos-dev-idle -g rg-api -n <database> --throughput <RU/s>   (or: az cosmosdb sql container throughput update ...)

name: bas-dev
costSource: estimated (Standard Bastion list price, 2 scale unit(s), eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: 0 Bastion sessions in 30 days (Standard, 2 scale unit(s)), billed hourly regardless
suggestedAction: Delete it and re-create it when needed (it takes about 10 minutes), or move dev/test use to the free Developer SKU.

name: asrseeddisk-web01-a1b2c3
costSource: estimated (P15 LRS list price, westeurope, Retail Prices API)
reason: Unattached for 45 days (LastOwnershipUpdateTime); looks like an Azure Site Recovery replica/seed disk
suggestedAction: Confirm with the resource group owner that the data isn't needed. If unsure, take an incremental snapshot (cheaper per GiB), then delete the disk.

name: crgraphapps
costSource: estimated (Basic registry list price incl. storage over the included amount, canadacentral, Retail Prices API)
reason: 0 image pulls by any client in 30 days; 3.0 GiB stored; still referenced by Container App(s) ca-graphdb. Scale-to-zero apps only pull when a replica starts, so deleting it would break the next scale-up.
suggestedAction: Keep it while the referencing Container App(s) exist. They pull from it when a replica starts. If those apps are retired, delete the registry along with them.

name: redis-session-old
costSource: estimated (Standard C1 list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: No client connected at any point in 30 days (Standard C1), but the cache bills every hour
suggestedAction: Confirm with the resource group owner that no app uses it (a connection string may sit in an app that's switched off), export the data if it matters (Premium can export to storage), then delete it.

name: demo-prod

suggestedAction: Advisor suggests: Buy a 1-year Dsv5 reservation (East US). Review it on the Advisor Cost tab.

wasteTypeLabel: Idle Container Apps with always-on replicas
name: ca-queue-worker
costSource: estimated (idle-rate list price x1 replica(s), westeurope; upper bound, free grant not applied, Retail Prices API)
reason: minReplicas 1 keeps replicas running, but there were 0 requests and 2.0 MiB of network traffic in 30 days; no HTTP ingress, so this is judged by network traffic only (a quiet background worker looks the same)
suggestedAction: Set minReplicas to 0 so it scales to zero when idle (the first request after idle then has a cold start), or delete the app if it's no longer needed.

name: stmediaarchive
costSource: estimated (Hot minus Cool LRS list price, westeurope, Retail Prices API)
reason: 2,048 GiB of blob data on the Hot tier with 0 GetBlob reads in 30 days. Cool stores it for less (reads cost more, and there's a 30-day minimum)
suggestedAction: Move it to the Cool tier: change the account's default tier, or add a lifecycle rule that tiers blobs not accessed for 30 days. Cool has a 30-day minimum and higher read cost, so skip this if reads are about to start.

name: stdevlogs
costSource: estimated (500 GiB RA-GRS minus LRS (Hot tier) list price; geo-replication traffic not included, pricing.json US East USD)
reason: Tagged env=dev but stores 500 GiB as RA-GRS, which keeps a second copy in another region. LRS keeps the data in one region (three copies) at a lower price per GB
suggestedAction: Confirm with the resource group owner that this data doesn't need a copy in a second region (a dev or test copy rarely does), then change the redundancy. GRS to LRS and GZRS to ZRS take effect at once; the secondary copy is removed.

wasteTypeLabel: Private endpoints with no working connection
name: pe-sql-rejected
costSource: estimated (private endpoint list price; data processed extra, pricing.json US East USD)
reason: Connection to sql-partner was Rejected by the owner of the target, so no traffic flows, but the endpoint bills hourly
suggestedAction: Ask the resource group owner whether the connection should be requested again; if not, delete the endpoint.

name: stgraphdata
costSource: estimated (all capacity at blob Hot LRS list price, canadacentral; approximate, Retail Prices API)
reason: 0 transactions on any service (blob, file, queue, table) in 30 days; 20.0 GiB stored; Container App(s) in the same resource group mount an Azure Files volume (ca-graphdb). This account may be their data store, idle only because the app is scaled to zero.
suggestedAction: Do NOT delete before confirming what uses it. A Container App in the same resource group mounts an Azure Files volume and this may be its data. If it is, it's not waste. Tag it waste-hunter:ignore=true to stop it being reported.

name: aks-nodepool1-nic-7
reason: No VM, private endpoint or private link service attached; lives in a platform-managed resource group, check the owning service first
suggestedAction: Delete the NIC if nothing will reattach it. This frees its private IP.

name: rg-old-poc
reason: Resource group contains no resources indexed by Resource Graph
suggestedAction: Delete it if nothing is about to be deployed there. Check for locks and role assignments others may rely on first.

name: Standard_D4s_v5 (bbbbbbbb)
idleSource: reservation summary (reserved vs used hours), 30 days
costSource: unknown (the reservation price is not readable with the allowed commands; the unused share of it is the waste)
reason: Used 30% of its reserved hours in the last 30 days (864 of 2,880 hours). The unused hours are prepaid and lost
suggestedAction: Find what it was bought for in the portal (Reservations > Utilization). Widen its scope to shared or a management group so more resources can use it, exchange it for a size or region that runs now, or let it lapse at renewal. Unused hours are not refunded.
